persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make three square listing photos for a plain sage-green ceramic mug: one on pure white, one on a cosy breakfast table, and one close-up of the rim and glaze. Same mug in all three, realistic photos, no text. Send them as separate images.
bank.Product appearance: A plain sage-green ceramic mug; exact shape is your call, but keep it identical across all three images.
bank.Required views: A pure-white-background shot, a cosy breakfast-table lifestyle shot, and a close-up of the rim and glaze.
bank.Style and mood: Realistic product photography, with a cosy mood for the lifestyle shot.
bank.Size and delivery: Three separate square images; 640 × 640 is fine.

messages.text: Could you make listing photos for a plain sage-green ceramic mug, because I’m trying to get the product pictures sorted out? I always worry a little about whether product photos will feel like they belong together. What I need is three square images, with one showing the mug on pure white and another showing it on a cosy breakfast table. The third should be a close-up of the rim and glaze, and it needs to be the same mug in all three. Please make them realistic photos with no text, and send them as separate images.
